# adaptive_msteams_workflow (Resource)

Manages a Microsoft Teams workflow integration. Webhook credentials remain in Terraform state when the server redacts them during refresh.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the MS Teams workflow integration.
- `webhook_url` (String) The webhook URL for the MS Teams workflow.

### Optional

- `last_updated` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
